thread:
incident-bot: Paging sara (oncall) — High tail latency + 5xx spike observed for inference endpoints in us-west-2 (az1a). Alert: backplane_queue_depth > 80% across g5 pool; 95th pct latency increased from 120ms -> 650ms.

incident-bot: Metrics: error_rate 4.8% (baseline 0.2%), success_rate_drop 6%, kv-cache-miss rate up x3. Logs show repeated ENIC queue drops and connection resets from a subset of instances.

sara (oncall): On it. Confirming — I'm seeing the same on the dashboard. Any recent deploys?

miguel (sre): No deploys in the last hour. Networking team flagged increased RX queues on AZ fabric for az1a ~ 30m ago. Might be zonal NIC/backplane saturation.

zara-ml: Customers reporting timeouts on generate and streaming stalls. SLO alert for p95 breaches. We need to quantify impacted customers — quick list?

jess-support: I have 3 active tickets mentioning repeated 502/504s in the last 20m, all apis hitting model-run endpoints in us-west-2. Escalating to SEs where needed.

sara (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic away from az1a via resolver steering (roll weights) 2) mark problematic hosts as draining 3) enable regional fallback to eu-west-1 for high-risk customers. Who can run steering?

miguel (sre): I'm running the DNS/route weight change now. Command: 
```
# increase weight for us-west-2-b and eu-west-1
infractl traffic steer --region us-west-2 --avoid-az az1a --add-backends us-west-2b=0.7,eu-west-1=0.3 --dry-run
infractl traffic steer --apply
```

miguel (sre): Applied. Should see connection churn for sessions pinned to az1a as clients reconnect. Expect some retries.

incident-bot: Noted change: resolver steering applied by miguel (sre) at 1755554340. Observability: route success % for new requests -> 92% to us-west-2b, 8% to eu-west-1 within 60s.

sara (oncall): Start draining bad nodes: listing g5 instances with queue depth > 70%.

miguel (sre): Running drain now. Patch to autoscaler: unblock scale-up across unaffected AZs. Also toggled circuit breaker to fail-fast for long-poll streams: 
```
route-config set cb_ms=1200 cb_fail_threshold=5
```

zara-ml: PV: can we temporarily disable long-running streaming responses for experimental models? That reduces stateful KV pressure.

sara (oncall): Good idea — disabling streaming for non-prod/model-tag=beta now.

jess-support: Customer comm suggestion: post a short postmortem note to status with message "Experiencing degraded inference latencies in us-west-2; mitigating by shifting traffic and draining affected hosts. No data exposure." I can draft.

ops-rotation: Observability note: KV-cache miss spikes correlate with instances that show ENET queue drops. Might be a NIC firmware/hardware flake. Suggest host isolation and reimage if flaps continue.

incident-bot: Observed immediate improvement in p95 after steering: p95 down to 240ms for routed traffic, overall error rate dropping to 1.6%. But a small cohort still hitting legacy pinned endpoints.

sara (oncall): For pinned sessions, we can issue a soft-evict signal to reconnect: 
```
controlplane evict-session --selector "az=az1a and pool=g5" --grace 10s
```

miguel (sre): Eviction triggered. Also kicked off host-level metrics export to vulcan for post-incident root cause.

zara-ml: Any indication of model process OOMs? Logs show no OOMs, just backlog on send buffers and occasional ECONNRESET.

jess-support: Draft ready for status: "Mitigation in progress — routing shifted from az1a to other AZs/regions; draining affected hosts; customers may see transient retries. We will update shortly." Approve? :thumbsup:

sara (oncall): Approve. Post now.

incident-bot: Status updated by jess-support at 1755554355.

ops-rotation: Next steps: 1) keep steering until we confirm stability ~30m 2) run NIC health checks on drained nodes 3) collect packet captures and ENI stats for vendor ops 4) open a ticket with cloud provider for 'backplane queue saturation' in az1a.

miguel (sre): I'll open the cloud ticket and paste the case number here. Case created: AWS-1234567890 — includes ENI metrics, host ids, and captures.

sara (oncall): Any high-severity customers still impacted? jess-support, list?

jess-support: Two customers on dedicated capacity reported >10% failed requests during the spike before steering — both notified. They want ETA for full recovery.

zara-ml: For dedicated, we may need to move reserved workloads to a different pool — will coordinate with sales/SE for manual failover.

incident-bot: Monitoring: error_rate now 0.9%, p95 ~180ms. Trend: stable for 3 min.

sara (oncall): Good. I'll hand off to miguel (sre) for longer-term remediation and tracking. Handoff note: keep steering enabled, run packet captures, coordinate with AWS, and confirm drained nodes either reimage or replace. Oncall rotation switch in 45m — if still active leave pager.

miguel (sre): Taking over. I'll set a follow-up thread for RCA and track AWS ticket.

deploy-bot: Auto-deploy blocker check: no pending deploys to inference fleet for next 2h — safe window for reimaging.

jess-support: Customer comm update in 15m: "We shifted traffic off affected AZ and are continuing validation. A small set of customers on pinned capacity were affected; engineers are working on targeted remediation."

incident-bot: Final autosummary: duration 18m active mitigation, primary symptom = ENI/backplane RX queue spike causing increased kv-cache misses and p95 latency; mitigation = resolver steering, draining hosts, enabling fail-fast circuit breaker, disabling non-prod streaming.

sara (oncall): Adding a quick action list for postmortem: collect host packet captures, NIC firmware versions, EVicted host IDs, app-send-buffer metrics, and timeline of steering changes. Also coordinate customer-level follow-ups for dedicated tenants.

miguel (sre): I'll own the postmortem. Will collect logs and assign RCA owners.

jess-support: Closing tickets that were transient? I'll keep them open until we have RCA link.

incident-bot: Handoff completed at 1755554367. If further paging occurs, please re-open the thread."
